# Tinct

Tinct is a reader for public-domain classics. Most books can be read free online in a modern English edition beside the original text, with AI help for any passage, audio narration, notes and highlights.

## How the public pages are organised

- Books: https://tinct.app/read/{book}. A book with a modern English edition opens on its first chapter (or first scene), with the list of all chapters below it.
- Chapter pages: https://tinct.app/read/{book}/chapter-N, the whole chapter in modern English with the original text in the same page.
- Shakespeare's plays: https://tinct.app/read/{play}/act-N-scene-M, one page per scene.
- How the editions are made: each book page carries the note. Tinct's modern English is drafted with AI from a public-domain translation or the original text, then checked by a separate AI review against it. The original is always one tap away.

## Main pages

- Home: https://tinct.app/
- Library: https://tinct.app/read

## Crawling guidance

Use the public HTML pages for citations and summaries. Do not crawl `/data/`, `/api/`, `/audio/`, or app-internal assets for bulk extraction. The edition texts are public-domain-derived, but the product experience, alignment, metadata and reading tools are the canonical Tinct surface.
